comment: Board-themed relics (Part 3c). Each is a small rule changer, read through Extras.has_relic.

relics.name: Steel Toe
relics.text: Your first push each fight goes 1 extra tile.

relics.name: Blood Chit
relics.text: A kill heals the one who made it for 1.

relics.name: Knee Pads
relics.text: The party takes 1 less from falls.

relics.name: Blast Vest
relics.text: The party takes 1 less from explosions.

relics.name: Slip Shoes
relics.text: Your first push each round gives 1 Move.

relics.name: Lucky Stub
relics.text: Your party's first card each fight costs 1 less MP.
